name: rotaris-crw
about: This repository's commands and places. {repo} is the primary checkout (git toplevel at render time); {id} is the plan id; agents read this skill from the orchestration's own detached reference worktree {repo}-wt-skillref-{id}; {node24} becomes the PATH export a host needs for Node 24, or a no-op where Node 24 is already the default; {node} becomes the Node 24 binary for a command that takes no shell prefix (the live runs: one absolute command each, since an agent's shell starts every command in the primary checkout and an allow rule matches only the command as sent). Session-specific values (trailers, extra push targets, model) come from the plan.

run.setup: pnpm install --prefer-offline && node node_modules/electron/install.js && pnpm symbols
run.afterMerge: pnpm install --prefer-offline (only if pnpm-lock.yaml changed) && pnpm symbols

proofs.run: timeout 1500 xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1600x1000x24" node apps/desktop/scripts/<name>.mjs --skip-build (drop --skip-build only where the script's header says it takes none; AGENTS.md's proof index says what each needs)

live.note: Each command names its own Node 24 binary, and the script judges the tree it sits in, whatever your directory. That tree needs the code-intelligence bundle, which the build does not make and without which a `--skip-build` launch refuses at once: run `pnpm code-intel:bundle` in it first (seconds when it is already there).

runs.what: the default live run, every scenario
duress, with the window the endpoint needs

autopsy.method: For the live-run packs (`.live-run/runs/<stamp>/`, the newest named in `.live-run/latest.txt`), follow .agents/skills/run-autopsy/SKILL.md for EVERY session; the product reader is apps/desktop/scripts/autopsy.mjs.
